description: The chart illustrates task counts by language family, with each family showing three bars indicating which model is labeled “better” (mBERT, XLM-R, or “same”). The horizontal axis contains the categories IE-Baltic, IE-Germanic, IE-Indic, IE-Romance, IE-Slavic, IE-other, Isolate, Semitic, and Uralic in that left-to-right order, and the vertical axis is labeled “task count” on a linear scale ranging from 0 to 40 with tick marks at 0, 10, 20, 30, and 40. For each category, three adjacent bars are shown: a light blue bar for mBERT, a dark blue bar for XLM-R, and a light green bar for “same,” as indicated by the legend in the upper right. Approximate bar heights are: IE-Baltic mBERT ~0, XLM-R ~10, same ~7; IE-Germanic mBERT ~4, XLM-R ~18, same ~22; IE-Indic mBERT ~1, XLM-R ~5, same ~4; IE-Romance mBERT ~4, XLM-R ~13, same ~30; IE-Slavic mBERT ~12, XLM-R ~39, same ~28; IE-other mBERT ~1, XLM-R ~6, same ~8; Isolate mBERT ~1, XLM-R ~5, same ~1; Semitic mBERT ~0, XLM-R ~7, same ~1; Uralic mBERT ~1, XLM-R ~14, same ~5. The bars are grouped by language family (side-by-side within each category) rather than stacked, there is no explicit sorting by bar height beyond the fixed category order, and no bars appear specially emphasized beyond the consistent color coding and the legend.
